newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Intl, Third Rail end merger.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Intl, Third Rail end merger.

text.p: Pacific International Enterprises Inc and Third Rail Inc on Friday said they cancelled their proposed merger by mutual consent.
The cancellation is not expected to have any adverse effect on the operations of either company.
"We feel this is a very positive move," Binks Graval, Pacific Intl chief executive officer, said in a statement. "(The decision) will free up additional time for management."
Graval said the cost to complete the deal was too great. It would have added $1.2 million in debt to the balance sheet and required additional cash of about $2.5 million.
